lines.text: The LORD does not change, so the descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed, yet they turned from His statutes.
The LORD tells the people to return to Him, and He will return to them.
The LORD says the people are robbing Him in feasts and offerings, and the whole nation is cursed.
The LORD says to bring the full tithe into the storehouse so there may be gold in His house.
The LORD will rebuke the devourer, and then all the nations will call the people blessed.
